card.name: Endings of Turkish and Arabic place names
card.fires_on: The final piece of transliterated Turkish or Arabic proper names ending in -iye, -iyye, -iyyah, such as Osmaniye or Suleymaniye. It fires on the ending 'ye', 'yy' or 'ah' after 'i'.
